rationale: The decision to proceed with F06 planning is well-founded. All four readiness criteria are met: (1) stable codebase with 97% test coverage and zero lint errors, (2) architectural decision already recorded in ADR-0002 with alternatives evaluated, (3) complete API specification in docs/API.md defining scope boundaries, and (4) roadmap alignment — Phase 4 REST API is the documented next milestone. The choice of PLAN_ONLY mode is appropriate given that F06 introduces a new framework (FastAPI), new dependencies (fastapi, uvicorn, pydantic), and a new architectural layer (HTTP routing, Pydantic schemas, dependency injection). Reviewing the Architect's decomposition before execution reduces the risk of scope misjudgment. No bias detected: the decision does not exhibit sunk-cost attachment to prior work, does not introduce scope creep beyond API.md, and correctly rejects deferral (Option B) since no blockers exist.
conditions: The Architect MUST scope F06 to the endpoints defined in docs/API.md — no speculative endpoints beyond the spec
ADR-0002 status should be updated from 'proposed' to 'accepted' as part of F06 Wave 0
The plan must address authentication as TBD (per API.md) without implementing it — auth is a separate feature
New dependencies (fastapi, uvicorn, pydantic) must be added to pyproject.toml with pinned versions
